besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses ('n Trommasjien maak ... / 'n sintetiseerder voeg ... by).
besluite.rede: Both halves have their own subject and verb, so the AWS comma before 'en' is required.

besluite.fout: Intransitive 'herhaal' copies English 'repeats'; Afrikaans uses the passive or reflexive.
besluite.rede: The passive is the natural Afrikaans form, matches 'herhaal word' later in the lesson, and keeps the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'Praat ... die woorde' is unidiomatic; praat does not take 'die woorde' as an object this way.
besluite.rede: Dropping the object reads naturally, loses no information (the words are implied) and matches the comparison list.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses (Komponiste skryf ... / ander musikante speel ...).
besluite.rede: Both halves have their own subject and verb, so the AWS comma before 'en' is required.

besluite.fout: 'uit al vier families en ander vir 'n kleiner groep' garden-paths as 'four families and other instruments'.
besluite.rede: Adding 'is' and the comma makes the second clause unmistakable without changing what is said.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma; without it 'n eie styl en musiek' reads at first as one object.
besluite.rede: Two full clauses joined by 'en' take the AWS comma, which also removes the stumble.
The gapped second half is still a contrasting clause and the comma reads well; removing it is not clearly better.

besluite.fout: 'hulle' does not agree with the singular 'n kwaito-groep of 'n komponis', and 'die eie manier' is wooden.
besluite.rede: 'sy eie manier van musiek maak' fixes the agreement, matches the lesson's own 'manier van speel' and 'sy styl', and keeps the meaning.
'jou eie en ander groepe se optredes' is a normal Afrikaans ellipsis, and 'jou groep' narrows 'jou eie', so the change is lateral at best.
In a glossary definition, 'oor en oor speel' without an object is acceptable Afrikaans for a device that plays repeatedly, so there is no real fault to fix.
